title: FeXoBot - Feature-Rich Discord Bot
shortDescription: A comprehensive, multi-purpose Discord bot with 100+ commands, advanced moderation, interactive games, AI integration, and extensive API integrations for enhanced server management.
features: Advanced Moderation: Complete warning system, ban/kick management, role control, and message purging
Interactive Games: Hangman, Tic-Tac-Toe, Pokémon database, and trivia with 4,000+ questions
AI-Powered Features: ChatGPT integration for intelligent responses and natural language processing
12+ API Integrations: NASA, PokeAPI, JokeAPI, Google Translate, Currency Converter, and more
Leveling System: XP tracking with automatic role rewards at levels 5, 10, 25, 50, and 100
Support Ticketing: Full ticket lifecycle management with transcripts and staff notifications
